highlights: Green Lion 2 In 1 Splitter Adapter Type-C to AUX & Type-C - Grey (GAD-11)
The Green Lion 2-in-1 Splitter Adapter is perfect for multitasking with Type-C devices.
Durable and full metal made of aluminum alloy and TPE, this adapter simultaneously allows 3.5mm AUX audio output and Type-C charging.
This plug-and-play adapter will allow you to listen to music or take calls while charging your device at 5V/2.4A.
Compact 12cm in cable length for portability and convenience, it is an accessory that should be carried around daily.
Get seamless audio and charging with this innovative Type-C adapter.
